root_idea.summary: The root centers on movement in a circuit or transition from one state, place, or relation to another.
root_idea.development: From turning and changing come meanings of intervening or separating, spatial surroundings, the yearly cycle, transfer, and the resourceful means by which an objective is reached.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested Form I verb with a distinct intervening or separating construction.
Primary nominal group for the spatial and temporal noun حَوْل.
Distinct noun حِوَل meaning removal or change of place.
Distinct noun حِيلَة meaning a means, plan, or expedient.
Derived Form II verbal noun with Quranic change and transfer uses.
The LOC/T group is the same lexical item حَوْل, used spatially and temporally; it is presented with the primary nominal group.

senses.definition: To intervene or come between, creating a separation or barrier.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in Quranic constructions with بَيْنَ for something that separates two persons, things, or an inner relation. The intervention may be understood as turning a person away from a desired course.

senses.definition: The area around, vicinity, or surroundings of something.
senses.usage_conditions: Used spatially, often in an adverbial construction with a following pronoun or noun, meaning around or in the environs of it.
Used for the completed yearly cycle and for a specified period of a year or years, as in حَوْلَيْنِ, two years.

senses.definition: Removal or change from one place to another; departure or escape.
senses.usage_conditions: In لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًا, it denotes not seeking removal from the abode; it is also explained as not seeking an evasion or way of escape from it.

senses.definition: A means, plan, expedient, or artful device for attaining an objective.
senses.usage_conditions: May involve concealed or subtle management, especially a way of escaping an unwanted situation or accomplishing what is sought.

senses.definition: Alteration or changing from one state, condition, or established course to another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for a change in a state, condition, or customary order; the Quranic examples concern the absence of alteration in a divine way or decree.

senses.definition: Transfer or removal of something from one place, recipient, or position to another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used transitively for shifting or transferring an object, benefit, or circumstance elsewhere.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become altered, changed, shifted, or transferred from a prior state, direction, or place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes change in constitution, condition, straightness, colour, or position; it may describe something becoming crooked or moving away from its place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To use an artful device or contrivance to manage a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use equated with احتال and associated with seeking a way through a difficulty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leap onto and seat oneself firmly on a horse or riding animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the back or middle of the riding animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a morning draught and an evening draught to become one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom for people suffering drought and scarcity of milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a year to pass, revolve, or become complete.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be said of a year passing over a person, house, food, or other thing; بِالْمَكَانِ can mean remaining in a place for a year or a long period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a female animal or woman not to conceive or become pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of a palm that bears one year and not the next, or fails to bear after fertilization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour or flow forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A use applied to a thing that pours out or forth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For an eye to squint or have its black turned toward an angle of the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact anatomical description varies among authorities; the common sense is a turned or squinting eye.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn an affair over in the mind and manage it by considering its possible results.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of changing one's opinion concerning an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To transfer or transcribe the contents of a book or writing to another copy without destroying the original.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use of transferring written contents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To declare or make something absurd, inconsistent, or impossible.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an utterance or proposition judged to be مُحَال.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a she-camel to fail to conceive after being covered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-breeding use, equated with the corresponding Form I expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire, seek, or endeavor to obtain something, often by resourceful management.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be pursued through an artful device, deliberation, or an attempt to induce someone to act.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look sharply or intently at someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use of directing one's sight toward the person observed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave abundance and turn toward hardship or scarcity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Preserved in a proverb about withdrawing from a meadow and setting off.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set upon, aim at, or attack someone with a whip, spear, or similar instrument.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe directing an attack or making death depend on the blows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reckon or esteem someone weak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive evaluative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For night to pour over the earth or come on.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive temporal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For food or another thing to make someone fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the person affected by the food or substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To do or say what is absurd, inconsistent, or impossible.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes making speech absurd or self-contradictory.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a man's camels to pass a year without conceiving.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of covered she-camels that do not become pregnant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refer a creditor or affair to another person by transferring responsibility for a debt or task.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In debt law, the debtor directs the creditor to another debtor or responsible party.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour water out or upon something, sometimes while turning over the vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of pouring from a bucket or directing water onto an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a year pass over someone or something, or to make the year complete.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative temporal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a man's she-camels to pass a year without becoming pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative breeding expression distinct from the intransitive failure to conceive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make an eye squint or become turned in its orientation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative anatomical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make speech absurd, inconsistent, or self-contradictory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied specifically to an utterance or statement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To employ evasions, shifts, or artful contrivances in managing a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Preserved in expressions praising or reproaching a person's resourcefulness and evasions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shift, move, depart, or transfer oneself from one place or state to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes turning into a new condition or direction; the lexical core is movement or transition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To carry a bundle on one's back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used when something is put into a cloak or garment and carried.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek to place oneself in a condition ready or willing to accept admonition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized reflexive use concerning receptivity to advice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be referred to another person for payment through a transfer of debt responsibility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal debt-transfer construction derived from الحوالة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To practise an evasion, stratagem, trick, or subtle device to achieve or avoid something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe ingenuity or cunning in managing affairs, whether blameworthy or merely skillful.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To encompass or surround someone, placing him in the midst of a group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct intransitive use from the artifice sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For speech or a thing to become absurd, impossible, or inconsistent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May mean becoming impossible in reality or being turned from its proper manner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To watch a person or cloud formation to see whether it moves or changes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive observational use expressing expectation of movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For land to become green and its herbage to stand strong and erect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or environmental specialization of becoming changed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The state, condition, case, or circumstance of a person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a changing condition in the soul, body, or possessions; in grammar, it can denote a state accompanying the subject or object, and in logic a transient quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A load, burden, bundle, or bundle of clothing carried on the back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense extends to a carrying bundle or burden.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment or piece of cloth used to gather and carry dry herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized garment sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A child's go-cart used for practising walking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A small cart-like object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part or middle of a horse's back bearing the saddle-cloth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to the central back or saddle-bearing portion of a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Black, fetid mud or soft earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same headword is also reported for related substances such as stinking flesh, hot ashes, acacia leaves gathered in cloth, and milk; these are lexicalized material uses rather than a general meaning of mud.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weakness or softness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from soft earth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Stinking flesh-meat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized material noun use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hot ashes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized material noun use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Acacia leaves beaten or shaken into a garment or cloth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized gathered-material use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal use attributed to Hudhayl.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strength, power, ability, or force.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense occurs in expressions such as لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله; it may also be interpreted as capacity for motion or turning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A furrow or trench in which palm trees are planted in a row.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agricultural technical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wonder or wonderful thing; by extension, wonders.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural and singular forms vary in the transmitted lexical reports.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An evil, abominable, or calamitous event.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be used as an epithet for something exceptionally disastrous.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The science of devices or mechanics.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical expression, علم الحيل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A yearling or something in its first year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to solid-hoofed animals, camels, plants, food, and a boy; the exact age extension varies by report.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The membrane or fluid-filled sac that comes out with or around a newborn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially the fetal membrane of a she-camel, analogous to the woman's placenta; the term is also applied to a woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abundance of water and green herbage, or land covered with dark green growth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use in comparisons with the fetal membrane and its contents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The changing or varying of time or fortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of temporal vicissitude.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The front, opposite side, or place facing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an adverb or noun meaning in front of, opposite, or facing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Independently or separately, by itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression عَلَى حِيَالِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cord tied between a camel's belly-girth and hind-girth to keep the latter from moving against the sheath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized piece of camel equipment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who is responsible or answerable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A personal noun of responsibility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A witness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Desire or seeking, especially seeking by artful management to attain an object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun associated with حَاوَلَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The diversion of one river or rivulet into another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agricultural or hydraulic technical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The transfer of a debt or claim by shifting responsibility from one person to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal and financial term for referral of a creditor or payment obligation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Responsibility or accountability.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A related nominal use of being answerable for an obligation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person skilled, experienced, or cunning in managing affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May imply extensive resourcefulness, subtlety, or skill in devising means.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something altered, changing, or turned, especially becoming black or changed in colour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a bone or other thing that has changed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female animal or woman that does not conceive or become pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially a she-camel after being covered; also applied to a palm that bears intermittently.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female camel young at the time of birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The corresponding male is called سَقْب.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing intervening as a separation, partition, fence, barrier, or obstacle between two things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal counterpart of the separating construction, with the lexical identity of حَائِل preserved.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Crooked, wry, or inclining to one side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Preserved in a proverb describing something that does not proceed straight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Alternating the cultivation of land by leaving it unsown one year and sowing it another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agricultural practice intended to strengthen the land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female that bears a male one year and a female the next, or bears a child of the opposite sex successively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a woman or she-camel; the report is qualified in the source as an alternative lexical attribution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A machine, wheel, or large pulley used in drawing water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical water-drawing implement, with variant descriptions of its exact construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The vertebrae, or a vertebra.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The number and whether the term is collective or singular vary in the lexical reports.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle of the back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily or anatomical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who says much that is absurd or self-contradictory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun referring to recurrent absurd speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land upon which rain has not fallen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical or figurative use reported for the adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place to which one shifts, removes, or becomes transferred.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal place sense distinct from the participial and infinitival grammatical uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Crooked or uneven, as of a leg, bow, or ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a leg crooked in its shank, a bow bent from straightness, or uneven land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land left unsown or uncultivated for a year or more.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agricultural specialization of land that has undergone a change of condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Full.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported lexical use in addition to the better-known sense impossible.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer to the Form I year use.
Pointer to the eye sense in Form I.
Pointer to the power sense of حَوْل.

cautions: The two QAC groups for حَوْل are merged because one is tagged nominal and the other spatial/temporal; their Quranic uses remain represented under the same public headword.
حِوَلًا in 18:108 supports removal or change of place, with an explicitly reported alternative interpretation of seeking an evasion; it should not be reduced to the contextual gloss “transfer” alone.
